content: अपथ {%a.%} [नास्ति पन्था यत्र] Pathless, roadless; ˚थो देशः, ˚था नगरी <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-थम्, -थः@} (also अपन्थाः <ls>P. V. 4. 72</ls>, <ls n="P.">II. 4. 30</ls>) .²1 Not a way, absence of a way or road, pathless state; a bad or wrong road (<ab>lit.</ab>); अपन्थानं तु गच्छन्तं सोदरोऽपि विमुञ्चति <ls>Rām.</ls> (<ab>fig.</ab>). irregularity, deviation, a moral irregularity or deviation, a wrong road, bad or evil course; अपथे पदमर्पयन्ति हि श्रुतवन्तोऽपि रजोनिमीलिताः <ls>R. 9. 74</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 54</ls>; न कश्चिद्वर्णानामपथमपकृष्टोऽपि भजते <ls>Ś. 5. 10</ls> follows evil ways; कारितस्त्वमपथे पदं मया <ls>Ki. 13. 45</ls>, <ls n="Ki. 13.">64</ls>. .²2 Heresy, heterodoxy (in opinions). .²3 The vulva. .{@-था@} Name of several plants. .{@-थम्@} {%ind.%} By or in the wrong way, astray; अपथं वर्तते <ls>Sk.</ls>
